text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The night before the Arima Kinen. Mejiro 
McQueen, recuperating from an injury, 
entrusts her hopes to Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Please, run in my stead—" Ikuno Dictus 
took Mejiro McQueen's heartfelt wish 
firmly into her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the day of the Arima Kinen arrived. 
Returning to the races, Tokai Teio was 
geared up to mark her comeback with a 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Ikuno Dictus has no intention of 
surrendering victory either. Exchanging 
declarations of war, the two head into the 
Arima Kinen—a guaranteed fierce battle is 
about to begin!
